# 国家哲学社会科学文献中心

## Localization result

The National Center for Philosophy and Social Sciences Documentation is an official Chinese social-science discovery and lawful-access source.

## Core knowledge

- Use it for Chinese social-science journal discovery, metadata cross-checking, and lawful full-text access where provided.
- Search fields may include title, author, keyword, abstract, journal, subject, institution, and date.
- Capture full citation metadata, document type, source, abstract/keywords, and full-text availability.
- It is particularly useful for social-science coverage and older or open Chinese journal content.
- Verify journal tier against the local FMS Chinese list.

## Agent workflow

1. Run the Chinese topic query and save the exact search string/date.
2. Filter to journal articles and export/capture metadata.
3. Use the official full-text route only when access terms permit.
4. Deduplicate with CNKI, Wanfang, and VIP results.

## Limits and stop conditions

- Availability of a full text does not establish methodological quality.
- Do not count non-journal records toward journal quotas.
- Do not bypass registration or access controls.

## Platform use

- 社科中文论文发现与合法全文获取

## Fields to extract or verify

- 题名
- 作者
- 期刊
- 全文状态
